TECHNICAL DETAILS
WHAT IT IS

A workspace for agent-style work.

Multiple workspaces, conversations, files, local model access and tool-assisted actions are organized around the task instead of a single disposable chat thread.

THE PROBLEM

Long tasks lose shape when context is scattered.

Once a job spans several files, decisions and tool steps, it becomes difficult to know what the model has available or what state should carry into the next action.

HOW IT WORKS

Workspace state is assembled before action.

The active conversation can be combined with relevant files and saved context. From there, the agent can respond, use a tool or continue the task while the interface keeps those steps visible.

PRODUCT ARCHITECTURE

05 / REAL PROJECT MACHINE LEARNING OWNER / mohamad-karimi
ASTROSEEINGAI

An astronomical seeing prediction framework built on XGBoost.

AstroSeeingAI is a machine learning framework that predicts real, instrument-measured astronomical seeing at ESO's Paranal Observatory, using multi-instrument site monitoring data instead of generic weather-forecast features.

RESULTS PANEL / ASTROSEEINGAI

Original visualization of the final model's reported results and model-progression comparison.

XGBoost (final)
TOP FEATURES Wind direction (sin/cos)2m temperature3h wind-speed trend

Seeing is driven by hyper-local atmospheric turbulence that only an observatory's own on-site instruments capture — general weather forecasts don't carry this signal. Repeated tuning showed diminishing returns after the first few passes, indicating the model sits near the practical ceiling for the data actually available.

PythonXGBoostOptunaDeep LearningPandas
TECHNICAL DETAILS
WHAT IT IS

A regression model for telescope-limiting seeing.

The project builds a supervised regression model that predicts astronomical seeing — the atmospheric blurring that limits telescope resolution — from real, site-specific atmospheric conditions at Paranal.

THE PROBLEM

Generic weather features are not enough.

Seeing depends on hyper-local atmospheric turbulence, so the model is built on real multi-instrument site monitoring data (2016–2026) rather than generic weather-forecast inputs.

HOW IT WORKS

DIMM, LHATPRO and meteo-tower data are merged and modeled.

All three instruments are aggregated to hourly statistics and inner-joined into 36,706 real hourly observations (April 2016 – July 2026), with seeing and airmass from the DIMM as the target and an Optuna-tuned XGBoost model learning from 23 engineered atmospheric features.

MODEL PIPELINE

From raw archive data to a trained model.

A product-level view of the known flow, from ESO's public archive exports to the final evaluated model.

01Archive DataDIMM · LHATPRO · meteo
→
02Build DatasetHourly merge
→
03Feature EngineeringRolling means · encodings
→
04Train / TuneXGBoost · Optuna
→
05EvaluateChronological hold-out
DATA SOURCES

Three real Paranal instruments.

A DIMM supplies the seeing target, an LHATPRO microwave radiometer supplies sky and water-vapour readings, and a 30m meteorological tower supplies temperature, wind and pressure — 36,706 hourly observations in total.

LEAKAGE CONTROL

A fourth instrument was deliberately excluded.

MASS turbulence data was left out because it is co-derived with the DIMM seeing target, and a weekly-block chronological split was used after an earlier random split overstated model skill.

TARGET HANDLING

A skewed target needed correcting.

92% of hourly seeing falls between 0.5″–1.5″, so training on raw values collapsed predictions toward the mean; training on log(1+seeing) and inverse-transforming fixed the poor-seeing tail.

FEATURE INSIGHT

Wind direction and near-surface temperature lead.

By permutation importance, wind direction (sin/cos), 2m temperature and horizontal wind speed rank highest; a 3-hour rolling wind-speed trend ranks fourth, confirming recent atmospheric change carries real signal.

MAIN CAPABILITIES

A full research pipeline.

  • Multi-instrument data merge
  • Leakage-aware feature engineering
  • Optuna hyperparameter tuning
  • XGBoost + DNN benchmarking
  • Chronological evaluation
  • Ensemble exploration
TECHNOLOGY

Known project stack

PythonXGBoostOptunaDeep LearningPandas

The pipeline covers dataset construction, a deep neural network baseline, an Optuna-tuned XGBoost model, and an ensemble evaluation script.

MY ROLE

End-to-end modeling on real observatory data.

Data EngineeringModel TuningEvaluation Design

The work centers on merging raw archive exports, engineering leakage-free features, tuning the model, and designing a chronological evaluation that reflects real forecasting conditions.

07 / REAL PROJECT AI / HEALTH ASSESSMENT WANDS / FUZZY LOGIC
FUZZY HEALTH

A health assessment system built on Python and fuzzy logic.

A data-driven health assessment system that evaluates mental and physical health indicators using BRFSS data and fuzzy logic. The system compares user responses with statistical reference values and provides an interpretable assessment.

Python Fuzzy Logic BRFSS Data Analysis HTML / CSS / JavaScript
TECHNICAL DETAILS
WHAT IT IS

A fuzzy-logic-based health assessment system.

The project evaluates mental and physical health indicators and analyzes user responses against statistical reference values derived from BRFSS data.

THE PROBLEM

Health indicators are not simply good or bad.

Health-related indicators can vary continuously. Fuzzy logic is used to represent different degrees of deviation instead of relying only on rigid boundaries.

HOW IT WORKS

From user responses to an interpretable assessment.

User responses are compared with statistical reference values. The distance is then processed through fuzzy membership functions to identify areas that may require further attention.

ASSESSMENT FLOW

From response to insight.

User responses are transformed into an interpretable fuzzy health assessment.

01 User Input Health questionnaire
→
02 BRFSS Data Statistical reference
→
03 Distance Deviation from mean
→
04 Fuzzy Logic Membership levels
→
05 Assessment Result & advice
MENTAL HEALTH

Mental health assessment.

Evaluation of selected indicators related to stress, restlessness, depressed mood, emotional support and life satisfaction.

PHYSICAL HEALTH

Physical health assessment.

Evaluation of selected physical health indicators related to physical health, mobility, self-care, sleep and daily limitations.

FUZZY MODEL

Fuzzy membership evaluation.

The distance between user responses and statistical reference values is mapped to fuzzy membership levels.

DATA SOURCE

BRFSS-based analysis.

BRFSS data provides the statistical foundation for the assessment and comparison process.

TECHNOLOGY

Project stack.

Python Pandas NumPy Scikit-Fuzzy BRFSS HTML CSS JavaScript
